name: Live births, 2007–2025 (excludes race)
description: Interactive counts and rates of live births to Colorado residents from the Colorado Health Information Dataset (CoHID), filterable by year and county. Explore births by maternal demographics (age, country of origin, marital status, income, education), pregnancy and clinical characteristics (smoking, diabetes, hypertension, BMI, weight gain, prenatal care), infant characteristics (birth weight, gestation, plurality, breastfeeding, WIC participation), and delivery details (facility type, method of delivery, NICU admission). Race and Hispanic origin are not shown; see the companion dashboards for data by race.
topics: Maternal, Child, Adolescent, and Family Health

name: Live births, 2020–2025 (includes race)
description: Interactive counts and rates of live births to Colorado residents from the Colorado Health Information Dataset (CoHID), filterable by year and county. Explore births by maternal demographics (age, race, Hispanic origin, country of origin, marital status, income, education), pregnancy and clinical characteristics (smoking, diabetes, hypertension, BMI, weight gain, prenatal care), infant characteristics (birth weight, gestation, plurality, breastfeeding, WIC participation), and delivery details (facility type, method of delivery, NICU admission). Uses the 2020 Census race categories (races alone and two or more races) with Hispanic origin.
topics: Maternal, Child, Adolescent, and Family Health

name: Live births, 2007–2019 (historical race categories)
description: Interactive counts and rates of live births to Colorado residents from the Colorado Health Information Dataset (CoHID), filterable by year and county. Uses historical bridged (single) race categories with Hispanic origin.
topics: Maternal, Child, Adolescent, and Family Health

name: Birth defects
description: Counts and crude rates of birth defect cases among Colorado births from the Colorado Health Information Dataset (CoHID). Select a specific condition (such as anencephaly) and county to see cases over time and by maternal age, maternal race, maternal Hispanic origin, and infant sex.
topics: Maternal, Child, Adolescent, and Family Health

name: Deaths, 2000–2025 (excludes race)
description: Mortality counts, crude rates, and age-adjusted rates for Colorado residents from the Colorado Health Information Dataset (CoHID), based on death certificates from the Vital Statistics Program. Filter deaths by cause, year, county, age group, sex, homelessness (from 2015), veteran status, and marital status. Race and Hispanic origin are not shown; see the companion dashboards for data by race.

name: Deaths, 2020–2025 (includes race)
description: Mortality counts, crude rates, and age-adjusted rates for Colorado residents from the Colorado Health Information Dataset (CoHID), based on death certificates from the Vital Statistics Program. Filter deaths by cause, year, county, age group, sex, race, Hispanic origin, homelessness, veteran status, and marital status. Uses the 2020 Census race categories (races alone and two or more races) with Hispanic origin.

name: Deaths, 2000–2019 (historical race categories)
description: Mortality counts, crude rates, and age-adjusted rates for Colorado residents from the Colorado Health Information Dataset (CoHID), based on death certificates from the Vital Statistics Program. Filter deaths by cause, year, county, age group, sex, race, Hispanic origin, veteran status, and marital status. Uses historical bridged (single) race categories with Hispanic origin.

name: Colorado population estimates
description: Colorado population estimates from the Colorado Health Information Dataset (CoHID), produced with the State Demography Office and used as denominators for vital statistics rates. View total population by county, sex, and age group, with one view for 2000–2019 using bridged (single) race categories and one for 2020–2025 using the 2020 Census race categories.

name: Cancer incidence, 2000–2023 (excludes race)
description: Age-adjusted cancer incidence rates for Colorado residents from the Colorado Central Cancer Registry, published through the Colorado Health Information Dataset (CoHID). Select a cancer site, county, and years, and compare rates by sex. Rates based on fewer than three cases are suppressed. Race and Hispanic origin are not shown; see the companion dashboards for data by race.
topics: Chronic Disease, Injury Prevention, and Behavioral Health Promotion

name: Cancer incidence, 2020–2023 (includes race)
description: Age-adjusted cancer incidence rates for Colorado residents from the Colorado Central Cancer Registry, published through the Colorado Health Information Dataset (CoHID). Select a cancer site, county, and years, and compare rates by sex, race, and Hispanic origin. Rates based on fewer than three cases are suppressed. Uses the 2020 Census race categories (races alone and two or more races) with Hispanic origin.
topics: Chronic Disease, Injury Prevention, and Behavioral Health Promotion

name: Cancer incidence, 2000–2020 (historical race categories)
description: Age-adjusted cancer incidence rates for Colorado residents from the Colorado Central Cancer Registry, published through the Colorado Health Information Dataset (CoHID). topics: Chronic Disease, Injury Prevention, and Behavioral Health Promotion

name: VISION chronic disease dashboard
description: Shows the burden of chronic disease in Colorado, organized around CDPHE's 1-3-4-50 model. Health factors include alcohol use, cancer prevention and screening, mental health, nutrition, oral health access, physical activity, and tobacco use. Health outcomes include cardiovascular health, diabetes, older adult health, oral health, respiratory illness, suicide, and weight status. Each indicator has trend charts, tables, maps, and downloadable data, and the dashboard highlights how place and structural factors shape health disparities.
topics: Chronic Disease, Injury Prevention, and Behavioral Health Promotion

name: Colorado health indicators (CHI) dashboard
description: A set of public health indicators at the county, regional, and state level that together describe the overall health of a community. Indicators are grouped into social and institutional equity, living conditions, health behaviors, disease and injury, and mortality. The dashboard supports Colorado's Health Assessment and Planning System (CHAPS) and includes data source information sheets and archived data downloads.

name: Colorado maternal and child health dashboard
description: Brings together key maternal, infant, child, and youth health indicators from state and federal sources, including PRAMS, the Baby & You survey, the National Survey of Children's Health, the Maternal Mortality Prevention Program, and the Newborn Hearing Screening Program. The landing page shows the latest state-level data. Indicator tabs add trends, demographic breakdowns, and county or regional data where available, with downloadable spreadsheets.
topics: Maternal, Child, Adolescent, and Family Health
population: Pregnant people, infants, children, and youth

name: Developmental screening to referral snapshot
description: An annual snapshot of developmental screening and referral for young children in Colorado. It combines 2024 Colorado Medicaid claims (HCPF), Early Intervention Colorado data, and HealthySteps site reporting. The snapshot shows screening and referral rates, points out gaps in the system from screening to services, and includes a data dictionary.
topics: Maternal, Child, Adolescent, and Family Health

Race and Hispanic origin are not shown; see the companion dashboards for data by race.

name: Colorado motor vehicle crash problem identification dashboard
description: Describes motor vehicle crashes in Colorado so that transportation, law enforcement, local agencies, and prevention partners can find traffic safety problems and target prevention. Views cover injuries and crashes by year and county, contributing factors, at-fault driver demographics, toxicology and alcohol impairment in fatal crashes, and safety behaviors of occupants and nonmotorists. A map overlays fatality and serious injury rates with EnviroScreen scores.
topics: Chronic Disease, Injury Prevention, and Behavioral Health Promotion

name: Homicide deaths, 2004–2025 (excludes race)
description: Homicide deaths in Colorado from the Colorado Violent Death Reporting System (COVDRS) and Vital Statistics death certificates. Includes counts, crude rates, and age-adjusted rates by age, sex, veteran status, marital status, method, and county, along with homicide, victim, and suspect circumstances. Race and Hispanic origin are not shown; see the companion dashboards for data by race.

name: Child fatality prevention system (CFPS) dashboard
description: Data from Colorado's Child Fatality Prevention System, which reviews all deaths of infants, children, and youth under age 18 that occur in Colorado. Topic pages cover suicide, sudden unexpected infant death, motor vehicle and other transportation, child maltreatment, firearms, drowning, homicide, and poisoning and overdose. Each page shows counts, rates, and circumstances, with filters for year, demographics, and jurisdiction.
topics: Maternal, Child, Adolescent, and Family Health
Chronic Disease, Injury Prevention, and Behavioral Health Promotion

name: Drug overdose deaths, 2000–2025 (excludes race)
description: Drug overdose deaths among Colorado residents from Vital Statistics death certificates, covering all intents. Shows counts, crude rates, and age-adjusted rates by drug type, county, age, sex, veteran status, marital status, and homelessness. Race and Hispanic origin are not shown; see the companion dashboards for data by race.
topics: Chronic Disease, Injury Prevention, and Behavioral Health Promotion

description: Drug overdose deaths among Colorado residents from Vital Statistics death certificates, covering all intents. Shows counts, crude rates, and age-adjusted rates by drug type, county, age, sex, race, Hispanic origin, veteran status, marital status, and homelessness. Uses the 2020 Census race categories (races alone and two or more races) with Hispanic origin.
topics: Chronic Disease, Injury Prevention, and Behavioral Health Promotion

name: State unintentional drug overdose reporting system (SUDORS)
description: Detailed data on unintentional drug overdose deaths in Colorado from the State Unintentional Drug Overdose Reporting System. Covers circumstances, toxicology, where the fatal overdose happened, overdose-specific circumstances, overdose response and bystander presence, and decedents' industry and occupation. Each chart compares a selected population with the whole state, and includes race and Hispanic origin.
topics: Chronic Disease, Injury Prevention, and Behavioral Health Promotion

name: Colorado drug-related ED and hospital utilization dashboard
description: Colorado Hospital Association data on nonfatal drug overdoses and substance use disorder diagnoses in emergency departments and hospitals. Use it to track how drug use shows up in hospital and ED visits across Colorado.
topics: Chronic Disease, Injury Prevention, and Behavioral Health Promotion

name: Near real-time nonfatal drug overdose ED visits
description: Preliminary, frequently updated syndromic surveillance data on emergency department visits for drug overdose in participating Colorado counties, which together account for over 90% of ED visits statewide. It supports situational awareness of overdose trends by month, county, age group, race, sex, and ethnicity. Counts are provisional and subject to change.
topics: Chronic Disease, Injury Prevention, and Behavioral Health Promotion

name: Injury indicators dashboard
description: Injury data for Colorado residents. Covers injury deaths plus hospital discharges and emergency department visits, each shown as counts, crude rates, and age-adjusted rates.
topics: Chronic Disease, Injury Prevention, and Behavioral Health Promotion

name: Sexual violence in Colorado dashboard
description: From CDPHE's Sexual Violence Prevention Program. It shares data on sexual violence in Colorado from population survey data and Colorado Hospital Association emergency department data. It is meant to support community-level primary prevention that addresses shared root causes of violence, such as economic opportunity and community connectedness.
topics: Chronic Disease, Injury Prevention, and Behavioral Health Promotion

name: Colorado oral health surveillance dashboard
description: A range of oral health indicators for tracking oral disease and risk factors, spotting emerging issues, and planning oral health programs. It has three sections: maternal and child oral health (ages 0-18 and pregnant people), adult oral health (including older adults and oral cancers), and oral health care access (dental provider shortages and why Coloradans do or don't get dental care).
topics: Access to and Linkage with Healthcare

name: Colorado EnviroScreen
description: An interactive environmental justice mapping tool built by CDPHE with Colorado State University and the Colorado School of Public Health. It combines 35 indicators of environmental exposures and effects, climate vulnerability, sensitive populations (such as asthma, cancer, diabetes, and heart disease prevalence), and demographics into a score of combined environmental and health stressors for each community. Look up an address to see its scores, download the data, or generate a PDF report for an area.
topics: Chronic Disease, Injury Prevention, and Behavioral Health Promotion

name: Private well water dashboard
description: County-level private well water quality across Colorado for four contaminants: arsenic, nitrate, uranium, and coliform bacteria. For each, it shows the highest level measured in private wells and the percent of samples above the U.S. EPA Maximum Contaminant Level, from 2011 to 2020. It helps identify areas where groundwater quality may be a concern. These data don't show individual exposure and are not a substitute for testing a private well.

name: Wastewater surveillance dashboard
description: Results from CDPHE's Wastewater Surveillance Program, which works with wastewater utilities to test for infectious pathogens including COVID-19 (SARS-CoV-2), influenza, RSV, enterovirus D68 (EV-D68), mpox, measles, and West Nile virus. Pathogens can show up in wastewater before people have symptoms, and from people who are infected but never have symptoms, so this complements other disease surveillance. Data are shown by monitoring site and can be downloaded from the CDPHE Open Data Portal.
topics: Communicable Disease Prevention, Investigation and Control
population: Communities served by participating wastewater utilities

name: School and childcare immunization data
description: Immunization and exemption data for Colorado colleges and universities, schools, and licensed childcare, based on data each licensed childcare, school, or district reports to CDPHE every year. Look up a specific site's data, or view it by county and state. A dashboard user guide explains how to navigate it, and the data can be downloaded from the CDPHE Open Data Portal.
topics: Communicable Disease Prevention, Investigation and Control
population: Children and students in licensed childcare, K-12 schools, and colleges/universities

name: Health facility search site
description: Find and compare licensed health facilities in Colorado and see their survey inspection results and occurrence reports. Search by facility name and address, facility ID, facility type (such as critical access hospitals, short-term hospitals, and other licensed facility types), county, city, or payor source (Medicare, Medicaid, private pay). For each facility, view its contact details and operating status, its list of inspections and occurrences, the text and regulation behind each citation, the facility's plan of correction, and descriptions of reported occurrences.
topics: Access to and Linkage with Healthcare
